units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 58b:11">B. Mets. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>גדולה אוֹנָאַת דברים מא׳ ממון</he> the wrong you do by means of words (wounding one’s feelings) is worse than that by pecuniary imposition.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 59a:8">Ib. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>לעולם יהא … באוֹנָאַת אשתו וכ׳</he> one should always be on his guard not to wound his wife’s feeling, for as her tears are frequent <he>אוֹנָאָתָהּ מרובה</he> so is her sense of wrong (sensibility) deep.

senses.gloss: (law) imposition, overreaching, fraudulent representation (which invalidates the transaction or requires redress); hence, redress in case of overreaching.
units: Y. B. Mets. IV, 9ᵈ top, a. fr. whoever concludes a bargain במנת שאין לו א׳ וכ׳ with the provision that no legal redress shall be resorted to, is notwithstanding entitled to redress.—Denomin. Verb (אוֹנָה), Hithpa. הִתְאוֹנֶה to be imposed upon, to feel one’s self overreached.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 4:3:3">Y. B. Mets. IV, 9ᵈ</cite> top. <he>בשעה שהמוכר מִתְאוֹנֶה וכ׳</he> if the seller sues for undue advantage taken of him, he has the privilege of redress, provided the advantage amounts to one fifth or more of the price charged; if the buyer sues &c. [In Babli the denomin. verb is <he>אִינָּה</he>, v. <cite ref="A02216"><he>אני</he></cite>.]
